initiatives.name: Riot Act Books
initiatives.description: A radical bookstore fostering mutual aid and community power through accessible literature and cultural programming. They provide a space for political education, resource sharing, and movement building while creating a hub for radical literature and community organizing.

initiatives.name: Binghamton PLOT
initiatives.description: We are a collective of advocates organizing in the Southern Tier around issues of race, class and gender!

initiatives.name: Binghamton Tenants Union
initiatives.description: Connecting tenants in Broome County to each other & sharing resources so renters can stay in their homes.

initiatives.name: Binghamton Food Rescue
initiatives.description: We provide rescued food from local farmers' markets at no cost to individuals and organizations that would otherwise not have access to enough healthy, affordable food.

initiatives.name: PM Press @ 21 Emma St
initiatives.description: The @pmpressorg warehouse in Binghamton, NY. Updates on PM events and mutual aid in the 607

initiatives.name: Justice and Unity for the Southern Tier (JUST)
initiatives.description: Works to end mass incarceration and policing in Binghamton and the Southern Tier, with jail advocacy, support for incarcerated people and their families, and the Books Over Walls program.

initiatives.name: Greater Binghamton ICE Watch
initiatives.description: Documents and reports ICE activity in the Greater Binghamton area, including Endicott and Endwell, through Instagram posts and videos.

initiatives.name: Concerned Residents of Greater Binghamton
initiatives.description: Immigrant rights group in the Greater Binghamton area. Shares know-your-rights materials and family preparedness planning, and runs rapid response support for ICE incidents.

initiatives.name: The Yiddish Bund of Binghamton
initiatives.description: Anti-Zionist Jewish student group at Binghamton University. Hosts Shabbat gatherings and events and promotes Yiddish culture.

initiatives.name: SJP Binghamton
initiatives.description: Student group at Binghamton University focused on Palestinian solidarity. Holds educational sessions, potlucks and rallies, and campaigns for BDS.

initiatives.name: Indivisible Binghamton
initiatives.description: Local chapter of the national Indivisible movement in Greater Binghamton and Broome County. Holds weekly protests, postcard and calling campaigns, and voter turnout drives.

initiatives.name: Greater Binghamton DSA
initiatives.description: Democratic Socialists of America chapter serving Binghamton and Broome County. Holds bi-weekly chapter meetings and organizes around the New York Health Act.

initiatives.name: CHOW Fresh
initiatives.description: Food recovery and distribution program in Broome County. Runs free food pantries and CHOW Fresh mobile markets that bring groceries to different locations around Binghamton.

initiatives.name: VINES (Volunteers Improving Neighborhood Environments)
initiatives.description: Binghamton nonprofit running 20+ community gardens, an urban farm, a youth summer jobs program, farm share, gardening workshops and community composting.
